newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Diesel gets Calif. engine order.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Diesel gets Calif. engine order.

text.p: Detroit Diesel Corp said Wednesday it received an order for 70 of its Detroit Diesel 6V-92 turbocharged and aftercooled engines from the Los Angeles Metropolitan Transit Authority.
It also received an order for an additional 30 6V-92TA long blocks.
The ethanol-powered engines provide low oxides of nitrogen emissions. The value of the order was not disclosed.
The company said it received emission certification of ethanol-fueled transit bus engines from the California Air Resources Board.
